about: keel's commands for terminal clients: keel TUI (cli/), the xal client (clients/xal) and any other front end. One table: names, arguments, help text, whether a command writes (decides a gate, starts or stops a flow), what its argument completes from, and local = it never calls keel. keel TUI builds its commands from it (cli/src/core/commands.ts, a test keeps both the same). Every request a client sends says who acts: X-Keel-Via (tui, xal, mcp), X-Keel-Client (its name and version) and X-Keel-Tool (the command); the api records a write as a <via>.call event.
